title: 19-BCV-020(REV1) - Structural insulated panels

facts.text: The revision allows Structural Insulated Panels (SIPs) in buildings constructed under Part 9.
CCMC-evaluated SIPs are recognized when used within the evaluation’s conditions and limitations; the report must be given to the AHJ and AHJ field inspections apply.
facts.locator: Same PDF, pp. 2 and 4, Discussion and Variance, item 1

facts.text: A non-CCMC alternative requires a Division C Section 2.3 alternative solution submitted by a registered professional, with approved plans/specifications and field reviews under Sentence 2.4.2.1.(9).
facts.locator: Same PDF, pp. 2 and 4, Discussion and Variance, items 2–3

facts.text: Appendix A lists example information: product/material/use, panel sizes/faces, supporting standards/testing, design details, limitations/maintenance, and code analysis.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
